agent_notes: All published totals retained. Hierarchical and subtotal rows are not additive. Blank cells are omitted, not imputed. Full estimate/RSE labels are preserved in estimate_type; RSEs are not estimates. Reference period is 2009–10 unless a separate period header specifies otherwise. Crime and population context may be embedded in the title. Born overseas and Employed are grouping stubs where no values are printed. Total born overseas and Total offenders known retain their published subtotals. Incident-count totals count incidents rather than victims. Non-reporting reasons are nested under non-reporting; property types and other multiple-response categories may overlap. Medical treatment rows describe injured victims only.
